cases.sentence: Я не гляну на тебя с жалостью и не пощажу; Я непременно накажу тебя за твое поведение и ___.
cases.explain: «омерзительные обычаи» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: My eye will not spare you, neither will I have pity; but I will bring your ways on you, and your abominations will be among you. Then you will know that I am Yahweh.’

cases.sentence: Скоро Я изолью на тебя Свою ярость и обращу на тебя Свой гнев; Я буду судить тебя по твоим поступкам и накажу тебя за твои ___.
cases.explain: «омерзительные обычаи» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Now I will shortly pour out my wrath on you, and accomplish my anger against you, and will judge you according to your ways. I will bring on you all your abominations.

cases.sentence: Из ___, которыми они гордились, они сделали омерзительные истуканы, свои гнусности.
cases.explain: «прекрасных украшений» — after the preposition «из», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: As for the beauty of his ornament, he set it in majesty; but they made the images of their abominations and their detestable things therein. Therefore I have made it to them as an unclean thing.

cases.sentence: Готовь цепи , потому что страна полна ___, а город объят насилием.
cases.explain: «кровавых преступлений» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “ ‘Make chains; for the land is full of bloody crimes, and the city is full of violence.

cases.sentence: Беда последует за бедой, и за слухами — ___.
cases.explain: «новые слухи» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Mischief will come on mischief, and rumor will be on rumor. They will seek a vision of the prophet; but the law will perish from the priest, and counsel from the elders.
